name: editing one model and one role preserves unknown fields, other providers and unedited roles

case.config:
modelRoles:
  default: alpha/one
  smol: beta/small
  customRole: alpha/one
retry:
  maxRetries: 3
unverifiedExtension:
  keep: true
case.models:
providers:
  alpha:
    api: openai-responses
    baseUrl: https://alpha.example.test/v1
    apiKey: ${OMP_ALPHA_API_KEY}
    customProviderField:
      keep: true
    models:
      - id: one
        name: One
        contextWindow: 200000
        customModelField: keep
      - id: two
        name: Two
  beta:
    api: anthropic-messages
    baseUrl: https://beta.example.test
    auth: none
    models:
      - id: small
